authority: Labor Code art.87; DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits 2024 (https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Workers-Statutory-Monetary-Benefits-Handbook-2024-Edition.pdf) ch.4 §C and ch.1 §A: hours beyond eight a day at 125% of the hourly rate on an ordinary day, 169% on a rest or special day, 195% on a special day that is the rest day or on a double special day, 253.5% on a double special rest day, 260% / 338% on a regular holiday (rest day), 390% / 507% on a double holiday (`work.days[].overtime_hours`, the approved hours). Rates: a day is the monthly basic × 12 ÷ `terms.facts.days_per_year` (DOLE Handbook ch.2 §D–E; 313 when unrecorded), or the contract’s own daily rate when `terms.facts.rate_basis` is DAILY (customer input); an hour is that day ÷ `terms.facts.hours_per_day` (8 when unrecorded). A monthly salary already pays the days its factor counts (regular holidays always; special days on 365/313/261; rest days on 365), so a worked day adds what the Handbook total exceeds that; a daily-paid contract is paid every worked or paid day on its own (Omnibus Rules Book III Rule IV s.2).

authority: Labor Code art.94; Omnibus Rules Implementing the Labor Code (https://elibrary.judiciary.gov.ph/thebookshelf/showdocs/2/85819) Book III Rule IV ss.2, 6, 10; DOLE Handbook on Workers’ Statutory Monetary Benefits 2024 (https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Workers-Statutory-Monetary-Benefits-Handbook-2024-Edition.pdf) ch.2: a daily-paid employee is paid 100% for an unworked regular holiday (a double holiday adds the DOUBLE_HOLIDAY_UNWORKED line), unless on leave without pay on the working day immediately before it — a rest day or non-working day in between is skipped (s.6(c)), and of two successive holidays the second is paid when the first is worked (s.10). Rates: a day is the monthly basic × 12 ÷ `terms.facts.days_per_year` (DOLE Handbook ch.2 §D–E; 313 when unrecorded), or the contract’s own daily rate when `terms.facts.rate_basis` is DAILY (customer input); an hour is that day ÷ `terms.facts.hours_per_day` (8 when unrecorded). A monthly salary already pays the days its factor counts (regular holidays always; special days on 365/313/261; rest days on 365), so a worked day adds what the Handbook total exceeds that; a daily-paid contract is paid every worked or paid day on its own (Omnibus Rules Book III Rule IV s.2).

name: Wages during a work suspension
authority: The pay of the suspended days whose kind pays (suspension_kind `pay`): DO 198-18 s.24 (OSH Standards 2020 edition, https://web.archive.org/web/2022id_/https://oshc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/OSH-Standard-2020.pdf, read 2026-10-07) — wages during a work stoppage for imminent danger caused by the employer’s violation or fault, the employer presumed at fault. A wage like the basic salary for SSS, Pag-IBIG and WTAX; PhilHealth stays on the contractual basic.

name: Unpaid days of a work suspension
quantity: double(size(work.days.filter(d, (has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null) && d.day_type == "WORK" && !d.worked && d.suspended.pay == 0.0 && d.suspended.kind != "WORK_STOPPAGE_ORDER" && !(has(d.suspended.facts.paid_by_agreement) && d.suspended.facts.paid_by_agreement == true))))
eligibility: !(has(terms.facts.rate_basis) && terms.facts.rate_basis == "DAILY") && work.days.exists(d, (has(d.suspended) && d.suspended != null) && d.day_type == "WORK" && !d.worked && d.suspended.pay == 0.0 && d.suspended.kind != "WORK_STOPPAGE_ORDER" && !(has(d.suspended.facts.paid_by_agreement) && d.suspended.facts.paid_by_agreement == true))
authority: “No work, no pay” (DOLE Handbook 2024, https://nwpc.dole.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/Workers-Statutory-Monetary-Benefits-Handbook-2024-Edition.pdf, ch.2 §I: days taken off may be deducted “consistent with the principle of ‘no work, no pay.’ This is without prejudice to an agreement or company policy which provides otherwise”; Labor Code art.301 and Omnibus Rules Book VI Rule I s.12 as amended by DO 215-20: the relationship is suspended and wages follow “existing laws ... and the applicable individual or collective bargaining agreement and voluntary employer practice or policy”). A monthly salary is reduced at the daily rate (the NO_PAY_LEAVE divisor) for each scheduled workday of an unpaid suspension not worked, unless the suspension records an agreement or policy that pays it (`facts.paid_by_agreement`, customer input). A daily-paid contract is simply not paid the day.
